I enjoyed the movie but i can't "just" watch it. Every scene make me frightened and nervous.

Don't know what to say to review this film, because words are not enough to describe it. This is one of the best movie I've ever watched this year. Spectacular!!

That suspense ! , the plot, This movie bangs!!! Heartwarming, and intense at the same time. I am amazed at how amazing this movie is. This is Human-heroes, not super-heroes. Great movie! Highly recommended.
I thought it was funny, heartwarming, and intense at the same time. i am amazed at how amazing this movie is. definitely worth to be seen at the movies!

This is his first film but looks like he has got everything to continue on his success. I applause him and his team. Writing was also good but the action scenes were quite awesome. Cast was also very successful. Everything about this film was so realistic. I can't help to think after seeing Korean cinema's high standards and humanity examples, mostly Holywood cinema should stop waste of resources with their wornout stereotype stories. May be they can invent other mediums to avoid such a failure in cinema history. I think only living thing is over there, Latin Amerikan cinema, they are also doing very good, unique and creative examples.

Driven perfectly with its insane storyline , everything adds up to either develop a character or to advance in the story. As a watcher , this is what I usually expect from a movie like this.

Koreans know best how to create such good movies in a genre packed with action, psychological horror and comedy but in the same time it maintains being a family-friendly movie.

Should've said this one word , it is "balanced".
